Ideal location for holidays of sport, culture and relax and the best place there to organize conferences, meetings and events.

Name: Terme Di Saturnia
Company description: Terme Di Saturnia is a premier wellness and spa destination located in the heart of Tuscany, renowned for its natural thermal springs and luxurious spa services. The company is dedicated to providing an exceptional experience that promotes relaxation, rejuvenation, and holistic well-being, aligning with its mission to enhance the quality of life for its guests. Terme Di Saturnia caters to a diverse clientele, including wellness seekers, golf enthusiasts, and luxury travelers, offering a range of services from spa treatments to golf tournaments. The company partners with various organizations to host exclusive events and competitions, further enriching the experience for its members and guests. With accolades from prestigious travel awards, Terme Di Saturnia continues to solidify its reputation as one of the top destination spas in the world.

Name: Castelfalfi
Company description: Castelfalfi is an enchanting 2,700-acre estate set between the provinces of Florence and Pisa, comprising a 5-star hotel with its medieval castle, ancient borgo, organic agricultural estate and winery, relaxing wellness spa and tranquil Tuscan villas. We are proud that Castelfalfi has been ranked the No. 1 Resort in Italy, No. 2 Resort in Europe and No. 17 in the Top 100 Hotels in the World in the Travel + Leisure World’s Best Awards 2025. This recognition is joined by the prestigious Forbes 5 Stars, the honor of receiving Two MICHELIN Keys in the Inaugural MICHELIN Guide's New Hotel Distinction, and the certification as a Great Place To Work™ 2025. A haven of serenity where time stands still and noise fades away to birdsong. Welcome to Castelfalfi.

Name: CampusX
Company description: We were born in 2011 with the name CampusX and with one big vision: to revolutionize the student campus offer in Italy, following the most evolved Scandinavian and Anglo-Saxon models, and re-thinking them for the eco-sustainable, connected, smart world of today. Today, with 6 urban resorts, more than 2000 rooms and 3000 beds, CX is much more than student housing. It's a vibrant, open community, continuously evolving, very environment-conscious, respectful of everyone's identity, in which people bring their own story, their own views of the world, their own culture and their own passions without any kind of labels or discrimination. It's a physical place but also a way to look at the world. A way to feel at home away from home. A way not only to live but to feel alive. A way to be yourself while constantly rediscover a new you. A way we simply call The X way of Living. Not because it cannot be defined, but because we all define it in our own way. We explore it by following our own path. We embrace it as our own force for good, for positive change, for progress. From who we are to who we want to be.

Name: THE COCOON COLLECTION
Company description: Welcome to the Cocoon Collection, the new luxury resorts collection which represents forty years of love for the Indian Ocean by the Azzola family: You & Me, Cocoon and Joy Island at the Maldives, The Island Pongwe, Gold Zanzibar Beach House & Spa and Bawe Island in beautiful Zanzibar. Nature, uniqueness, design, culture of places, elegant welcoming and research in taste blend together to create a balanced soul, addressed to  the Guest wellness, through a customized hospitality.  The Cocoon philosophy reconnect people to places, to gestures and smiles which remain in the memory.  Privacy, high standard services, fine food, extraordinary views: all the collection offers a real contact with nature with the comfort  requested by highly demanding clients. Human values are reflected also in Sofia Luna Azzola Foundation and other educational projects for the land development.

Name: Palazzo Parigi Hotel & Grand Spa
Company description: Aperto nel 2013, Palazzo Parigi Hotel & Grand Spa è la visione dell'Architetto Paola Giambelli, creatrice e Managing Director, in collaborazione con Pierre-Yves Rochon, uno dei più importanti interior designer del mondo degli hotel a cinque stelle. Nel cuore di Milano, a 400 mt. dal quartiere di Montenapoleone e dal Teatro alla Scala, Palazzo Parigi offre l'esperienza milanese per eccellenza con un tocco contemporaneo.  95 tra camere e suite con vista panoramica tutte caratterizzate da balconi o terrazze ed una Grand SPA di 1700 m² con hammam privato. Caffé Parigi ed il Ristorante Gastronomico sono i due fiori all'occhiello della proposta culinaria per una cena raffinata, un aperitivo chic o una rilassante colazione nel giardino privato.

Name: DoveVivo By Joivy
Company description: DoveVivo By Joivy is a pioneering coliving company that offers a diverse range of living solutions across various cities in Italy and abroad, catering primarily to students and young professionals. With over 11,000 fully furnished accommodations, including shared rooms, studios, and larger apartments, the company aims to create a community-oriented living experience that balances privacy with shared spaces. Joivy's mission is to provide flexible and hassle-free housing options, ensuring that residents feel at home while enjoying essential amenities such as coworking spaces and study areas. The company is committed to supporting its clients through a dedicated customer care service and an intuitive app that simplifies the management of their living arrangements. By fostering a sense of belonging among individuals from different backgrounds, Joivy envisions a vibrant community where residents can connect, share experiences, and thrive together.

Name: Federalberghi
Company description: Federalberghi da oltre cento anni è l'organizzazione nazionale maggiormente rappresentativa degli albergatori italiani. La federazione rappresenta le esigenze e le proposte delle imprese alberghiere nei confronti delle istituzioni e delle organizzazioni politiche, economiche e sindacali. Aderiscono a Federalberghi 132 Associazioni Territoriali, raggruppate in 19 Unioni Regionali, e 6 Sindacati Nazionali (Unione Nazionale Italiana Catene Alberghiere, Sindacato Grandi Alberghi, Sindacato Villaggi Turistici, Associazione Alberghi per la Gioventù, Federalberghi Isole Minori, Unihotel Franchising). In seno a Federalberghi sono costituiti 5 Comitati Nazionali (Mezzogiorno, Attività stagionali, Attività termali, Consorzi alberghieri, Giovani albergatori) Federalberghi aderisce dal 1950 a Confcommercio ove, insieme alle principali federazioni di categoria  che operano nel Turismo, ha dato vita a Confturismo, l'organizzazione di rappresentanza imprenditoriale di settore.  Federalberghi è socio fondatore di Hotrec, la Confederazione Europea degli imprenditori del settore alberghiero e della ristorazione.

Name: ITI MARINA Hotels & Resorts
HQ Location: Italy, Nu, Orosei, S.n.c. Via Del Mare, 08028
Company description: Born in 1978, the Sardinian hotel chain ITI MARINA Hotels & Resorts is made up of 33 hotels and resort, allocated on well-known beaches and cities on the beautiful island of Sardinia in Italy. From the Costa Smeralda to the South Sardinia azure, passing through the Gulf of Olbia, San Teodoro, Budoni, and Gulf of Orosei, every Eastern coastal area of the island welcomes one of the Company’s characteristic hotels. More than forty years of experience in hospitality, high quality services and guest care are the classic hotel standards that have always defined the solid values of the Company.

Name: Teamwork Hospitality
Company description: Teamwork Hospitality is a consulting firm specializing in the hospitality industry, dedicated to enhancing operational efficiency and strategic development for hotels and related businesses. The company's mission is to provide tailored solutions that empower clients to achieve their goals through effective training, consulting, and marketing strategies. Teamwork Hospitality collaborates with a diverse range of clients, including hotels like Coral Hotel, offering services that encompass corporate training, rebranding, and operational support. With a focus on delivering value and fostering long-term partnerships, the company aims to be a trusted ally for hospitality businesses seeking to thrive in a competitive market.

Name: Lindbergh Hotels
Company description: Lindbergh Hotels is a prominent hotel group in Italy, offering a diverse range of accommodations and services across various locations, including Pesaro, Taormina, Modica, and Perugia. The company operates several hotels, such as the Excelsior Hotel, Spa e Lido, Grand Hotel San Pietro, and Nautilus Family Hotel, catering to both leisure and business travelers. Lindbergh Hotels is committed to providing exceptional hospitality experiences, with a focus on sustainability and local culture, as reflected in their gourmet dining options like the Bàtu Gourmet Restaurant. Their target market includes families, couples, and business professionals seeking quality service and unique experiences in picturesque settings. Through strategic partnerships and a dedication to customer satisfaction, Lindbergh Hotels aims to enhance the travel experience while promoting the beauty and heritage of Italy.

Name: Ostello Bello
Company description: Ostello Bello is a vibrant hospitality company that operates a network of hostels across Italy, including key cities such as Milan, Rome, Naples, and Florence. The company aims to provide an inclusive and engaging environment for travelers, offering a range of accommodations and communal spaces designed to foster social interaction and cultural exchange. With a mission to create memorable experiences, Ostello Bello caters primarily to young travelers, groups, and adventure seekers looking to explore Italy's rich history and diverse landscapes. The hostels are strategically located in central areas, making it easy for guests to access local attractions and immerse themselves in the unique atmosphere of each city. Additionally, Ostello Bello emphasizes flexibility in its offerings, including customizable food options and event spaces, ensuring that every guest's needs are met. Through partnerships with local businesses and a commitment to sustainability, Ostello Bello strives to enhance the travel experience while promoting the local culture and community.

Name: AG | Coach Alberghiero
Company description: Alberto Gava utilizza il metodo unconventional coaching alberghiero perché permette di individuare le peculiarità sulle quali lavorare verticalmente per far crescere il business e raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi. Al centro di tutto c’è la persona, la struttura che rappresenta, la sua unicità. AG è un network di professionisti, guidati da Alberto Gava, che collaborano a fianco dei titolari o direttori delle strutture alberghiere, individuando i loro punti di forza, le potenzialità e l’unicità da far emergere. AG | Consulenze Alberghiere è una realtà che si occupa di accompagnare le strutture ricettive – Resort, Hotel, B&B, Villaggi Turistici – verso un percorso di crescita e miglioramento, prendendosi cura di diversi aspetti: dal revenue managerment al marketing turistico, dall’interior design alla gestione dell’accoglienza nelle sue svariate sfaccettature. AG ha un’unica mission: fare dell’ospitalità un’arte!

Name: Blu Hotels S.p.A.
Company description: Blu Hotels S.p.A. is a prominent Italian company in the hospitality sector, with over 30 years of experience and a dedicated workforce of more than 1,300 employees across its hotels and administrative offices. The company operates a diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts situated in prime tourist destinations throughout Italy, including regions such as Abruzzo, Alto Adige, Calabria, and Tuscany. Blu Hotels is committed to delivering exceptional service and creating memorable experiences for its guests, reflecting the rich tradition of Italian hospitality. The company caters to a broad target market, including families, couples, and business travelers, ensuring that each guest's needs are met with high standards of comfort and quality. With a mission centered on passion and dedication, Blu Hotels aims to be a benchmark in the hospitality industry, continuously expanding its reach and enhancing its service offerings. The company fosters a dynamic and inclusive work environment, promoting career growth opportunities for both newcomers and seasoned professionals. Blu Hotels values inclusivity and diversity, offering equal employment opportunities and cultivating a supportive atmosphere for its staff. By collaborating with various partners in the tourism and hospitality sectors, Blu Hotels enhances its offerings and broadens its audience. Through its commitment to outstanding hospitality, Blu Hotels S.p.A. strives to maintain high standards of quality and guest satisfaction, positioning itself as a leader in the Italian hotel industry.

Name: JSH Hotels & Resorts
Company description: THE PURSUIT OF HAPPINESS JSH Hotels Collection is a leading hotel management group that manages a global portfolio of 18 independent and international hotels and resorts in Italy, Austria, and Switzerland. Ours is a dynamic, young and diversified company whose key factor for success is the respect for a precise scale of corporate values and a culture of travel that by necessity departs from people. What does our guest look for when staying in our facilities? What do you expect? What are your needs, your expectations? How can we satisfy them? What can we and should we do if it is a disappointment? Finding the right answer to these questions is the founding principle of our work. Our research is complex, because the needs are increasingly more demanding, multiple and specific, and the response must be appropriate, and cannot be based on market segments, but must be instead “on target", focusing on the individual person. We all know that you are looking for more and more from your holiday; wellness and serenity, and to be able to break away from everyday life by immersing yourself in a relaxing and enjoyable dimension. Well-being can no longer come from generalist principles, or from flat and uniform standards. What people are looking for and what we want to offer is true well-being for everyone, even for those who have not been on vacation for a very long time. Expectations are diverse, for example for those who always enjoy fresh vegetable extract, or for the sportsman who wants to stay active on vacation. For the celiac baby who is gluten intolerant. For those who suffer from back pain and do not sleep well if the mattress is not rigid enough. For those who find the greatest achievement by reading a book under the stars or sipping a drink at sunset. Our sense of hospitality is the answer to these questions. Or rather, it is the very essence of our research, which never stops and makes us so dynamic, fluid, and ever projected towards innovation and mindful of new trends. The answer to these questions comes, every day, from the people who work in our hotels. From the chefs in the kitchen who spend their lives experimenting above a hot stove, to the reception staff who welcomes guests upon arrival. From the housekeeping staff, which makes the rooms perfect every morning, to the masseuse, who gives a moment of happiness through his hands. From the director, who is the “deus ex machina”, the ultimate problem solver of every area of the hotel, to the local coach, who focuses on opportunities outside of the hotel or resort to enable the guest to discover the splendor of the surrounding territories. Everyone, in his own way, works with one goal in mind: To meet the demands of the customer with a smile and to respond to needs and expectations, with promptness, sincerity and attentive care. Thanks to our ten-year experience as operators in the hotel management industry, we have advanced skills that enable us to manage very different assets, diversifying our products and enhancing their special characteristics, from boutique hotels to congress centers, from resorts to luxury segment. And we do this in collaboration with the most prestigious international brands, such as Hilton, Marriott, Radisson Blu, Holiday Inn. Our hotels provide experiences, emotions, well-being, and the discovery of the surrounding territories, cultures and traditions. We are promoters of a healthy lifestyle where sport, physical activity, good food, and personal care are indispensable. To ensure this, to succeed and maintain our leadership in the hospitality industry, we know we must focus on people, both inside and outside our company. There are over 1000 people who already work with us and contribute each day to our ambitious goals. And they will continue to grow. Our success is, above all, their success. ANDREA CIGARINI President & CEO JSH Hotels Collection

Name: Aries Group
HQ Location: Italy, Lombardy, Milan, 11 A Via Lampedusa, 20141
Company description: Aries Group è un gruppo alberghiero indipendente italiano attivo nelle principali città d’arte e di business in Italia, con hotel, resort e residence per il turismo congressuale, gli eventi (MICE), il leisure e business travel. Impegnato dal 2020 nello sviluppo di un progetto nuovo di ospitalità, il gruppo pone la cura di clienti e stakeholder al centro. Offre a persone e aziende strutture estese e servizi su misura nei quali l’innovazione e uno stile di accoglienza tipicamente italiano rappresentano caratteristica distintiva.  La profonda esperienza maturata dai soci fondatori nel settore dell’ospitalità consente di valorizzare, conservare e rendere profittevoli nel tempo gli asset in gestione. Per guidare la crescita, il Gruppo si avvale dell’efficienza operativa e della consolidata capacità commerciale dell’executive team. Il portafoglio attuale è costituito da Hotel Villa Pamphili Roma, Quark Hotel Milano, Living Place Hotel Bologna e Ripamonti Residence & Hotel Milano, con quattro centri congressuali, per un totale di 1.640 chiavi, 9.400 mq di spazi per eventi e 65 Sale Meeting.

Name: Hotel Palace
Company description: Hotel Palace Battipaglia – La tua base strategica per il business in Campania Situato nel cuore di Battipaglia (SA), a pochi minuti dall'autostrada A3, dalla stazione ferroviaria e a soli 12 minuti dal nuovo Aeroporto Salerno Costa d’Amalfi, l’Hotel Palace è la destinazione ideale per il viaggiatore d'affari. La struttura offre un perfetto equilibrio tra accoglienza, funzionalità e convenienza, grazie a servizi pensati per aziende e professionisti: Tariffe corporate e convenzioni aziendali Reception attiva 24/7 Ristorazione interna di qualità Business corner e Wi-Fi gratuito in tutto l’hotel Parcheggio gratuito Flessibilità nella cancellazione entro le 18:00 del giorno di arrivo Perfetto per meeting, incontri di lavoro, congressi ed eventi, l’Hotel Palace garantisce comfort e accessibilità in una posizione strategica nel cuore della provincia di Salerno, con collegamenti diretti verso la Costiera Amalfitana, il Cilento, la Calabria e la Sicilia.

Name: Invest Hospitality
Company description: Il progetto di Invest hospitality si basa sull’ottenere in tempi brevi, ed in particolare a Milano, un numero di strutture alberghiere con una disponibilità totale di almeno 5.000 posti letto, in location strategiche e commercialmente interessanti. La stessa impostazione con dimensioni e condizioni da verificare potrà essere adottata per opportunità nel mercato estero.

Name: Royal Group Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Royal Group hotels & resorts è un brand che racchiude quattro strutture ricettive del segmento lusso situate in Campania: l’Hotel Royal Continental a Napoli, il Parco dei Principi, il Relais Regina Giovanna e il So' Lifestyle Hotel a Sorrento.   Punto di riferimento per l’ospitalità in Italia, l’azienda gestisce alberghi molto diversi tra loro per vocazione e dimensioni, ma tutti accomunati dall’essere luoghi dinamici, votati non solo all’accoglienza turistica ma all’ospitalità a 360°. Gli hotel del gruppo sono, infatti, tutti dotati di ristoranti e bar aperti ai clienti esterni e costituiscono un punto di riferimento per il territorio, in linea con la vision aziendale che individua nella creazione di valore condiviso un obiettivo strategico.

Name: Grand Hotel Principe Di Piemonte
Company description: The Grand Hotel Principe di Piemonte emits a soul reminiscent of the Belle Époque, where intellectuals and celebrities used to gather in the roaring 20s. It’s now embellished with modern nuances after a careful and extensive renovation. The hotel, located in Viareggio, in the Tuscan Riviera, is the gateway to Portofino & Cinque Terre and a short drive to glamorous Forte dei Marmi, offering a range of activities from high-end shopping to exclusive beach clubs and restaurants. There’s a vast selection gastronomic experiences on property, from the award-winning breakfast to the 2 Michelin starred Il Piccolo Principe, the more casual-chic Maitò Viareggio, located in the property’s rooftop that features a panoramic infinity pool, where guests can also enjoy haute mixology cocktails with extensive views. The Spa offers a vast range of treatments and massages, as well as a Finnish sauna, a Turkish bath, a salidarium, sensory showers and a gym. Exclusive accommodations, including a Stefano Ricci designed Presidential suite, and various spacious sea view options, wrap up a complete experience for a diserning clientele looking for luxury heritage with a fresh, contemporary touch.

Name: Greenblu Hotels & Resorts
HQ Location: Italy, Apulia, Noci, Sn Zona Industriale, 70015
Company description: Il gruppo Greenblu Hotels & Resorts sviluppa attività nei settori del turismo, dello sport, dello spettacolo, del tempo libero e della cultura e promuove e organizza meeting, congressi, ricevimenti e convegni.

Name: Parc Hotels Italia
HQ Location: Italy, Brescia, Limone Sul Garda, 13 Via Campaldo, 25010
Company description: Parc Hotels Italia is a prominent player in the hospitality industry, specializing in providing consulting services aimed at increasing direct bookings for hotels. With over 60 years of experience, the company is dedicated to helping hoteliers navigate the competitive landscape dominated by Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) by promoting strategies that enhance direct customer engagement. Their mission is to empower hotel owners, both new and seasoned, to reduce dependency on intermediaries and foster lasting relationships with guests through effective communication and marketing techniques. Parc Hotels Italia collaborates with a diverse range of clients, including independent hotels and larger chains, focusing on enhancing their online presence and optimizing booking processes. The company’s innovative approach incorporates elements of neuromarketing and psychological strategies to attract and retain customers, ultimately aiming to boost occupancy rates and brand loyalty.

Name: Hotel Mediterraneo
Company description: Hotel Mediterraneo, situated in the picturesque Sottomarina di Chioggia, stands as a premier hospitality destination that seamlessly combines comfort with authentic local experiences. The hotel is dedicated to providing guests with a genuine taste of Chioggia, guiding them through the city's hidden gems and cultural highlights. With a strong emphasis on personalized service, Hotel Mediterraneo caters to a diverse clientele, including families, couples, and pet owners, ensuring that every guest feels at home during their stay. The hotel's mission is to create memorable experiences that reflect the true essence of the region, while its vision is to be recognized as a leading choice for travelers seeking both relaxation and adventure in Chioggia. Hotel Mediterraneo prides itself on exceptional accommodation and services, focusing on attention to detail to ensure that each stay is unique and enjoyable. The hotel attracts a varied clientele, including tourists, business professionals, and families, all of whom appreciate its strategic location and high-quality offerings. To enhance the guest experience, Hotel Mediterraneo collaborates with local businesses, offering activities such as bicycle rentals and guided tours that promote the surrounding area. This partnership not only enriches the visitor experience but also supports the local economy, making the hotel an ideal choice for those looking to explore the region. With its blend of modern amenities and traditional hospitality, Hotel Mediterraneo aims to be the preferred destination for both leisure and business travelers in Chioggia.

Name: Italian Hospitality Collection
Company description: Italian Hospitality Collection is a fast-paced, world-class hotel, resort and spa brand. Our mission is to acquire world-class hotel, resort and spa hospitality experiences that position the company as the number one Italian hospitality brand in Europe. We seek to provide rich, rewarding and authentic experiences for avid travellers who seek to feel loved, cherished and indulged in a lifestyle that embodies the splendour of all things Italian. Created in December 2014, we are striving to position ourselves as the ambassador of Italian Hospitality; a brand deeply rooted in Italian culture, art and nature, with its collection of exclusive hotels in landscapes of excellence: Sardinia, with its unique crystal-clear waters, Tuscany the country of thermal spas, history and unique wine routes. And today also Courmayeur, where majestic Mont Blanc towers above, crowned with white, against an impossibly blue sky. As part of our mission, we are seeking passionate, talented professionals who are ready to make a difference and step above the crowd.

Name: B&B Service
HQ Location: Italy, Tuscany, Camaiore, 11 Via Dei Carpentieri, 55041
Company description: Fondiamo la nostra impresa nel 1993 in provincia di Lucca per fornire, prevalentemente a favore di aziende ed enti locali, servizi di Facility Management complementari alle attività produttive.  Nel giro di pochi anni siamo riusciti ad affermarci in ambito nazionale acquisendo clienti sia nel settore pubblico che in quello privato. Alla base di questo trend c’è principalmente una politica aziendale sempre orientata verso la massima soddisfazione del cliente che sa di poter contare ogni giorno su un valido supporto nella gestione della propria attività. Abbiamo l’ambizione di riuscire ad adeguare la struttura aziendale al continuo cambiamento del mercato, interpretandone tempestivamente istanze e trasformazioni. Crediamo nella condivisione della visione strategica con i vari livelli dell’organizzazione, così da rendere tutti partecipi degli obiettivi. Basiamo la gestione della nostra impresa sulla ricerca di nuove tecnologie, su un attento coordinamento dei servizi e sulla puntuale formazione del personale. La progettazione, l’esecuzione e il controllo delle attività vengono integrati attraverso un’informatizzazione personalizzata dei processi. Del resto il nostro obiettivo è quello di essere protagonisti nel mondo dei servizi con professionalità ed etica, mettendo al centro i clienti e la collettività, valorizzando le competenze e le aspirazioni dei lavoratori, nel rispetto delle regole.

Name: Grand Hotel Et De Milan - Member Of The Leading Hotels Of The World
Company description: Grand Hotel et de Milan, a distinguished member of The Leading Hotels of the World, is a luxurious hotel located in the heart of Milan, Italy. Renowned for its historic charm and elegance, the hotel specializes in providing exceptional hospitality services, including exquisite wedding planning and event hosting. With a mission to create unforgettable experiences, the hotel offers personalized services tailored to the unique stories and desires of its clients, ensuring that every detail is meticulously crafted. Its target market includes discerning travelers, couples seeking romantic weddings, and those looking for a sophisticated venue for special occasions. The hotel collaborates with top-notch wedding planners, chefs, and photographers to deliver a seamless and memorable experience, making it a premier choice for both leisure and business guests.

Name: Uappala Hotels
Company description: Uappala Hotels is a new hotel company and one of the key player of the hotel industry in Italy. With 18 structures located in the most valued Italian regions (Tuscany, Emilia, Sardinia, Sicily, Veneto, Marche), it is implementing a significant development project, that will lead to the enlargement of its hotel portfolio as well as the affiliation of its properties to international hotel brands. For more information, visit our website www.uappala.com Current Vacancies: To apply, please send your CV to risorseumane@uappala.com

Name: ITI Hotels - Colonna Hotels & Resorts
Company description: ITI - Istituto Turistico Italiano was founded in 1921. Down the years ITI diversified his main interest in the residential tourism field, planning and building over 10,000 residential rooms. Today ITI HOTELS Group has 40 owned properties with a total of 10,000 beds, most of them located on the eastern coast of Sardinia - Costa Smeralda, as well as in Rome and in South, Central and North America (Buzios in Brazil, Antigua in the Caribbean and Washington in the USA).  It is considered national leader among hotel groups in Italy, thanks to the largest number of self-managed and owned properties.

Name: VRetreats
Company description: VRetreats, part of the Alpitour World hospitality division, is a collection of charming hotels and historic residences in Italy, dedicated to offering unique experiences for lovers of art, history, and culture. Founded in 2021, the company has rapidly expanded its portfolio, aiming to reach 12 properties by the end of 2023, with a total investment exceeding 24 million euros. VRetreats' mission is to redefine luxury, viewing it not as an end in itself but as a gateway to the beauty and culture of Italy, while highlighting the historical details and soul of its buildings. With an average daily rate (ADR) of approximately 500 euros, the company primarily serves an international clientele, with 80% of its guests coming from abroad, positioning itself in the premium market segment. The vision of VRetreats is to continue its growth trajectory, with projected revenues surpassing 57 million euros for 2023, driven by the acquisition of new hotels in iconic locations such as Siracusa, Lecce, Olbia, Cervinia, and Florence. VRetreats specializes in providing luxurious retreat experiences, focusing on high-end accommodations and personalized services tailored to discerning travelers. Its clientele includes couples, families, and business professionals seeking serene escapes or unique venues for events. The company collaborates with local artisans and culinary experts to enhance its offerings, ensuring that each retreat reflects the rich heritage and beauty of its surroundings. With a commitment to excellence, VRetreats aims to be a leader in the luxury hospitality sector, delivering exceptional service and memorable experiences that resonate with its guests.

Name: Grand Hotel Miramare
HQ Location: Italy, Liguria, Santa, 30 Via Milite Ignoto, 16038
Company description: Grand Hotel Miramare is a luxury hotel located in Portofino, Italy, offering an exquisite blend of comfort and elegance for discerning travelers. The hotel is dedicated to providing an exceptional experience, featuring beautifully appointed rooms and suites, gourmet dining options, and a range of wellness facilities including a pool, gardens, and beach access. With a mission to embody the essence of the Italian "dolce vita," Grand Hotel Miramare aims to create memorable moments for its guests through unique culinary experiences and personalized service. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, couples seeking romantic getaways, and business professionals looking for meeting spaces. Partnering with prestigious networks such as Leading Hotels of the World and Virtuoso, Grand Hotel Miramare targets a high-end market that values luxury, quality, and unforgettable experiences.

Name: Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria
Company description: The Excelsior Vittoria is an award-winning luxury hotel in the heart of Sorrento. Set in a unique location overlooking the Gulf of Naples, this 5 star Luxury hotel offers comforts with personalised service: - 84 beautiful rooms and suites, each with original period furniture; - The charming Bar Vittoria with breathtaking views and two fabulous restaurants: The Terrazza Bosquet a gourmet Seafront Restaurant and l’Orangerie poolside bar & restaurant; - Boutique Spa La Serra is a unique place, immersed in the lush Mediterranean vegetation; - State-of-the-art gym with dedicated personal trainers; - Stunning white marble swimming pool with Jacuzzi; - 20,000 square metres (5 acres) of lush Mediterranean garden with pleasant walks in the shade, citrus grove and olive; - Six stylish spaces for meetings and events; - Weddings organization facilities.

Name: Carattere Toscano Hotels & Resorts
HQ Location: Italy, Tuscany, Florence, 2 Via Del Melarancio, 50123
Company description: Carattere Toscano Hotels & Resorts means legitimacy and pride, authenticity and hospitality, love for tradition and innovation at the same time. Its uniqueness is due to the harmonic  fusion of the elegance with the efficiency of its facilities, all of them are apparently classic but with a contemporary taste and all of them are deeply rooted in Tuscany: from the Grand Hotel Baglioni in Florence to Resort Roccamare in Castiglione della Pescaia, from Borgo di Pietrafitta Relais in Castellina in Chianti, to the Grand Hotel Bastiani in Grosseto. All locations where Nature has the key role in creating a warm and welcoming ambiance which makes all guests feel like home, guaranteeing a genuine immersion into the quiet and silence of the magnificent Tuscan territory. The good taste is the main theme of the entire Group. This guarantees the excellence and the authenticity of our proposals and it distinguishes every aspect of the evocative experience that can be lived inside all of our facilities. But Carattere Toscano is way more. It’s the essence of your holiday in Tuscany.

Name: Borgo Santo Pietro Lifestyle Group
Company description: Borgo Santo Pietro Lifestyle Group is a luxury boutique hotel located in the heart of Tuscany, designed to provide an exquisite blend of nature and sophisticated luxury. Founded by Jeanette and Claus Thottrup, the hotel aims to create a unique sanctuary for relaxation and wellness, offering a serene escape from everyday stress. The property features therapeutic gardens, a spa that utilizes natural essential oils from its own medicinal plants, and a range of wellness treatments that promote healing and rejuvenation. Catering primarily to discerning travelers seeking romantic getaways, special celebrations, or wellness retreats, Borgo Santo Pietro emphasizes attention to detail and exceptional service, ensuring a memorable experience for its guests. The hotel collaborates with various partners in the luxury travel sector, including Leading Hotels and Virtuoso, to enhance its offerings and reach a global clientele.

Name: Capri Tiberio Palace
Company description: Capri Tiberio Palace has shined as the favourite destination for the utmost sophisticated international jetset since its new takeover. Major enhancements every year further emphasize the absolute uniqueness of the magic atmosphere that portrays the home of a globetrotter in the glamorous island of Capri, Italy. The new version of the luxury boutique hotel exhales an eclectic vibe, absolutely unequalled throughout the island. The exclusive five star hotel, located in the heart of Capri's movida - a short stroll away from the famous Piazzetta - is still a private getaway with its intimate and privileged position. This precious gem is filled by worldwide travellers and bon vivants who savour splashes of multiethnic and contemporary design, yet are fully attuned to the myth of the island, appreciating its essence and values topped by warmth and excellence.

Name: L Albereta Relais & Chateaux - Espace Chenot Health Wellness Spa
HQ Location: Italy, Lombardy, Erbusco, 23 Via Vittorio Emanuele, 25030
Company description: Suggestivo relais in Franciacorta che sorge tra le sinuosità di dolci colline coltivate a vigneti, L’Albereta coinvolge i propri ospiti in un’esperienza indimenticabile, perché qui l’arte dell’ospitalità è intesa come capacità di garantire benessere assoluto e sublime piacere dei sensi.

Name: Xenia Hotellerie Solution SpA SB
Company description: Xenia Hotellerie Solution SpA SB engages in the provision of hospitality services. The company is headquartered in Guardiagrele, Chieti and currently employs 205 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2023-11-06. Xenia operates in the Italian market of accommodation, hotel, and tourism services. In addition to its facilities in Italy, Xenia also manages its presence in Albania, Switzerland, and London. The firm operates into two segments: Xenia and Phi Hotels. The brand Xenia is involved in two activities: Crew Accommodation that is responsible for managing the entire process of relocation and hotel accommodation of airline, rail, sea, cargo, etc. crews by identifying means and accommodations; and GDS Distribution System called XENIAtoBOOK (Global Distribution System involved with the reservations management software of hotels). The other segment Phi Hotels is engaged in the direct management of hotel facilities.

Name: Compagnia Degli Hotel CDH
Company description: Dear Guest, Compagnia Degli Hotel is a chain of five hotels: - CDH Hotel Bologna - CDH Hotel Villa Ducale | Parma - CDH Hotel Modena  - CDH Hotel La Spezia - CDH Hotel Radda | Radda in Chianti (SI) We provide comfort and facility for your travel, for work or pleasure, trying to satisfy each request. These are the reasons that lead us to develop a good job, working hard to Welcome you also outside your home! Enjoy your stay with Compagnia Degli Hotel

Name: OMNIA HOTELS
Company description: OMNIA HOTELS è nata nel 2019 dalla naturale evoluzione del  Gruppo LO.AN. La catena pone le basi sull' esperienza nel mercato romano, costruita nel corso degli ultimi 40 anni  e la genuina passione della Famiglia Lazzarini per il mondo dell’ospitalità. 8 Alberghi a 4 Stelle, quasi 1000 camere in aree strategiche di Roma. Seguiteci e sarete sempre informati!!!

Name: Belvedere Bellagio
Company description: Belvedere Bellagio is a charming hotel and restaurant located in the picturesque town of Bellagio, Italy, overlooking the stunning Lake Como. Established in 1880, the company has been family-owned for five generations, embodying a deep commitment to hospitality and authenticity. Its mission is to provide guests with a unique experience that celebrates local culture and culinary traditions, while its vision focuses on creating lasting connections through shared moments and flavors. The restaurant, Albòri, features a menu inspired by the region's rich agricultural heritage, showcasing dishes that reflect the chef's Sardinian roots and a fusion of culinary influences. Belvedere Bellagio caters to a diverse clientele, including families, couples, and travelers seeking a tranquil retreat, and partners with local artisans and farmers to ensure the highest quality ingredients. The hotel emphasizes a relaxed atmosphere, encouraging guests to savor the beauty of their surroundings and the simplicity of life by the lake.

Name: R Collection Hotels
Company description: R Collection Hotels is a distinguished hospitality group that operates a collection of luxury hotels and restaurants, primarily located in Italy. The company is renowned for its unique blend of luxury and tradition, exemplified by properties such as the Grand Hotel Bristol Spa Resort. R Collection Hotels is dedicated to providing guests with extraordinary experiences that celebrate the essence of La Dolce Vita, characterized by elegance, comfort, and exceptional service. With a mission to create unforgettable moments, the company focuses on high-quality accommodations, exquisite dining options, and wellness services, including the ERRE SPA, which offers personalized treatments in a serene atmosphere. The target market for R Collection Hotels includes discerning travelers seeking refined getaways in picturesque locations, particularly along the stunning Ligurian coast and the enchanting landscapes of Lake Como. The group caters to both leisure and business travelers, making it a preferred choice for those celebrating special occasions or seeking a tranquil retreat. R Collection Hotels partners with local culinary experts and artisans to enhance its offerings, ensuring that guests are immersed in the rich cultural heritage of Italy. By showcasing regional flavors and ingredients through fine dining experiences, the company appeals to food enthusiasts and those looking for authentic Italian cuisine. Through its commitment to exceptional guest experiences and attention to detail, R Collection Hotels aims to create memorable stays that resonate with visitors long after their departure. The combination of traditional Italian hospitality and modern innovation positions R Collection Hotels as a leader in the luxury hospitality sector, dedicated to exceeding the expectations of its clients and partners alike.

Name: Sardegna Resorts
Company description: COSTA SMERALDA There’s no end to the fascinating culture of Sardinia, the island of longevity: take your first steps around Porto Cervo through the mistery of its megalithic ruins, town festivals that celebrate the glories of its past, handicrafts that demonstrate the illustrious traditions of its artisans, and a flavourful cuisine that highlights its local products at the heart of Sardinian people’s long lifespans. From crystal-clear turquoise water, pristine beaches, untouched nature and stunning architecture to luxurious hotels, wellness centers, designer boutiques, world-class restaurants and exciting nightlife. For a memorable vacation, private event or wedding celebration that will satisfy even the most demanding traveler, discover one of the most iconic destinations: Costa Smeralda

Name: Le Sirenuse
Company description: Le Sirenuse ha aperto nel 1951 quando Aldo, Paolo, Franco e Anna Sersale decisero di trasformare la loro casa al mare in un piccolo albergo di charme affacciato sulla baia di Positano. Oggi le Sirenuse ha 58 camere e il servizio di un grande albergo, pur mantenendo sempre lo spirito e l’atmosfera di una casa privata.

Name: Cosmo Hotel S.p.A.
Company description: Cosmo Hotel S.p.A. è un giovane gruppo alberghiero in espansione attualmente composto da 2 strutture ricettive site in Cinisello Balsamo e Vimercate rispettivamente di 201 e 127 camere, una struttura Residence di 60 appartamenti, una Villa storica dedicata ad eventistica e banchettistica ed il nuovo hotel 5 stelle lusso Palazzo Parigi Hotel & Grand Spa nel centro di Milano.

Name: Weisses Kreuz Südtirol / Croce Bianca Bolzano
Company description: Weisses Kreuz Südtirol, also known as Croce Bianca Bolzano, is a distinguished four-star adults-only hotel located in the picturesque Val Venosta region of South Tyrol. The hotel offers a unique blend of historical charm and modern design, featuring 47 elegantly appointed rooms and suites that reflect a timeless aesthetic. With a mission to provide authentic hospitality and a tranquil retreat, Weisses Kreuz emphasizes relaxation, gourmet dining, and a deep connection to nature, making it an ideal destination for discerning travelers seeking a peaceful getaway. The hotel is committed to excellence, as evidenced by numerous accolades and awards, and it caters primarily to adults looking for a special vacation experience in a serene environment. Guests can indulge in wellness offerings, fine cuisine, and breathtaking views, all while enjoying the rich history and culture of the region.

Name: AS HOTELS Milano - Monza & Brianza
Company description: AS HOTELS Milano - Monza & Brianza is a collection of five modern four-star hotels strategically located in the northern regions of Milan, Monza, and Brianza. The company aims to provide exceptional hospitality and comfort for both business and leisure travelers, offering a total of 600 rooms across its properties. With a focus on accessibility to major industrial areas and trade fairs, AS HOTELS caters primarily to corporate clients and event organizers, ensuring efficient service and competitive pricing. The hotels are equipped with meeting facilities and are well-suited for hosting business events, making them a preferred choice for those visiting the Milan Rho exhibition center and surrounding industrial hubs. AS HOTELS is committed to delivering quality accommodations and excellent dining options, all while maintaining a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction and value for money.

Name: Chia Laguna
HQ Location: Italy, Sardinia, Domus De Maria - Chia
Company description: The Chia Laguna welcomes you to the natural paradise of Chia, along the south-west coast of Sardinia, famous for its 6 kilometres of untouched coastline where the crystal-clear sea laps the soft white sand dunes.    With young couples and families in mind, or for lovers of outdoor activities, and for those of you seeking well-being and relaxation, the Chia Laguna provides impeccable hospitality in its 3 exclusive hotels and luxury villas

Name: Windows On Europe
Company description: Welcome to Windows on Europe Spa Page ge on LinkedIn! Follow us for regular updates on the activities of the Group and recruitment opportunities!                                                                                                            The Group Windows on Europe is specialized in the management of serviced apartments, vacation rentals, villas for rent and temporary offices, with direct presence in ten cities, 6 countries and with an apartment booking service covering major cities around the world. With over 25 years of experience, Windows on Europe has developed specific expertise regarding the management of both holiday properties and office buildings. Short term rental operators can take advantage of this know how through a service platform. Alongside this managerial expertise the Group has adopted a sophisticated distribution strategy which unites both online and offline channels. Presently, clients from all over the world rent from the Group more than 1,300 properties which it manages directly, as well as tens of thousands which are managed by 200 professional operators in 150 locations worldwide, with a transaction volume in 2012 of 20 million euros. In the Products Tab you’ll find the main brands of the Group.

Name: EDIT
Company description: EDIT is a vibrant culinary destination that combines a unique dining experience with a focus on innovative flavors and high-quality ingredients. The restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring a range of dishes, from artisanal tapas to expertly grilled meats, all designed to surprise and delight the palate. With a mission to create memorable moments through food and drink, EDIT aims to provide a welcoming atmosphere for both casual diners and those seeking a more refined culinary adventure. The establishment caters to a broad clientele, including food enthusiasts, local residents, and visitors looking for a distinctive dining experience. Partnering with local suppliers and emphasizing seasonal ingredients, EDIT is committed to sustainability and supporting the community while delivering exceptional service and a memorable dining experience.

Name: Batani Select Hotels & Events
Company description: Batani Select Hotels & Events is a premier hospitality company specializing in luxury accommodations and event management across several stunning locations in Italy, including Rimini, Cesenatico, and Milano Marittima. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional guest experiences through its five-star hotels, which feature exclusive amenities such as private beaches, gourmet dining, and wellness programs. Batani Select Hotels & Events aims to create memorable stays for both leisure and business travelers, offering tailored services that cater to individual needs. Its clientele includes families, couples, and corporate groups seeking a blend of relaxation and sophistication. The company partners with local businesses and event organizers to enhance its offerings, ensuring guests enjoy the best of the region's culture and attractions. With a commitment to excellence, Batani Select Hotels & Events strives to be a leader in the luxury hospitality sector, delivering unparalleled service and unforgettable experiences.

Name: Club Medici
Company description: Club Medici è l’associazione dei medici per i medici che opera sul territorio nazionale ed è aperta a tutti gli iscritti agli albi provinciali. Da oltre trenta anni si prende cura del medico nel suo percorso professionale e di vita.

Name: La Lumaca
Company description: Con i nostri progetti di educazione ambientale, comunicazione ambientale e servizi educativi diffondiamo la sostenibilità e combattiamo la povertà educativa. Accompagniamo aziende, PA, scuole, famiglie ad avere comportamenti più consapevoli e responsabili nei confronti del Pianeta e, per farlo, siamo sempre alla ricerca di nuovi linguaggi e modalità. Con 60.000 studenti incontrati ogni anno siamo leader in Italia in educazione ambientale.

Name: Zacchera Hotels
Company description: Beautifully situated on Lake Maggiore, Zacchera Hotels is one of the leading Italian groups in the hospitality industry with 5 prestigious properties: Grand Hotel Dino (Baveno), Grand Hotel Bristol (Stresa), Hotel Simplon (Baveno), Hotel Splendid (Baveno), Residence Carl & Do (Baveno).

Name: Pacini Group
Company description: For over 20 years, we have been involved in hospitality development, crafting memorable experiences with a multidisciplinary approach and an unconventional vision. Pacini Group's results are characterized by a welcoming style and personalized service.  Passion and creativity are the pillars of the company led by Emidio Pacini, applied with constant commitment to the pursuit of ever-innovative achievements.  The accumulated experience allows us to develop and generate value through an integrated system of partnerships and affiliations, achieving an eclectic hospitality with notes of excellence and originality.

Name: Grand Hotel Parker's - Member Of Relais&Châteaux
Company description: Il Grand Hotel Parker's è un prestigioso hotel a cinque stelle situato a Napoli, noto per la sua eccellenza nell'ospitalità e per la sua storica eleganza. La missione dell'hotel è quella di offrire un'esperienza indimenticabile ai propri ospiti, combinando comfort moderni con il fascino della tradizione napoletana. Con una varietà di servizi, tra cui il ristorante stellato Michelin "George" e il Bidder Bar con vista panoramica sul Golfo di Napoli, l'hotel si rivolge a una clientela di alto livello, tra cui viaggiatori d'affari, turisti e famiglie in cerca di un soggiorno esclusivo. Inoltre, il Grand Hotel Parker's è impegnato in iniziative di responsabilità sociale, collaborando con organizzazioni locali per sostenere la comunità e promuovere l'inclusione sociale. Con un'attenzione particolare alla sostenibilità e all'arte, l'hotel si propone di essere un punto di riferimento non solo per il turismo, ma anche per la cultura e il benessere della città.

Name: BWH Hotels Italy & South-East Europe
Company description: BWH Hotels Italia & Malta is a prominent hotel group that operates under the brands WorldHotels, Best Western, and SureStay Hotels, with a strong presence in over 100 countries and 4,500 properties worldwide. Established in 2019, the company has quickly become a leader in the Italian hospitality market, boasting 170 hotels across the nation. BWH Hotels is managed by a cooperative of hoteliers and employs a dedicated team of 70 professionals based in Milan, focusing on delivering quality, innovation, and tailored solutions to its network of hotels. The company's mission is to foster the growth of hospitality businesses through effective solutions and valuable connections, ensuring every guest enjoys a contemporary, inclusive, and sustainable experience. With a commitment to sustainability, BWH Hotels has implemented initiatives like Stay for the Planet and StayPlasticLess, collaborating with partners such as LifeGate to minimize environmental impact. The group also emphasizes loyalty programs, with over 57 million members benefiting from exclusive offers and dedicated rates.

Name: Rome Marriott Park Hotel
Company description: Rome Marriott Park Hotel is a premier hospitality destination located in the heart of Rome, dedicated to providing luxurious accommodations and exceptional service to both leisure and business travelers. The hotel aims to create a unique blend of comfort and elegance, allowing guests to immerse themselves in the rich culture and history of Rome while enjoying modern amenities. With a strong focus on sustainability and wellness, the hotel features spacious rooms, a state-of-the-art wellness center, and a variety of dining options that cater to diverse tastes and preferences. Targeting families, couples, and corporate clients, the Rome Marriott Park Hotel serves as a sophisticated retreat in a vibrant city, making it an ideal choice for those looking to explore the beauty of Rome. The hotel partners with local businesses and attractions to enhance guest experiences, ensuring that visitors can fully appreciate the city's offerings. With versatile meeting spaces and elegant dining options, the hotel caters to a diverse clientele, from tourists exploring the historic city to corporate guests attending conferences. The hotel's mission is to deliver "Wonderful Hospitality. Always," which reflects its commitment to ensuring that every guest feels valued and appreciated during their stay. As part of the Marriott International portfolio, Rome Marriott Park Hotel benefits from a global network of partners and resources, enhancing its ability to meet the needs of its guests while maintaining a focus on sustainability and community engagement. With its upscale amenities and welcoming atmosphere, the Rome Marriott Park Hotel stands out as a premier choice for travelers seeking a luxurious experience in one of the world's most iconic cities.

Name: La Toscanini
Company description: La Toscanini, officially known as Filarmonica Toscanini, is a prestigious orchestra based in Parma, Italy, dedicated to delivering exceptional musical performances that blend tradition with innovation. Founded in 2002, the orchestra has quickly established itself as one of Italy's leading orchestras, performing in renowned concert halls worldwide and collaborating with esteemed conductors and soloists. The organization's mission is to promote classical music through high-quality performances and educational initiatives, aiming to engage diverse audiences and foster a love for the arts. With a vision to serve as a cultural ambassador for the Emilia-Romagna region, La Toscanini celebrates its rich musical heritage while fostering a new generation of music lovers. The recent appointment of Maestro Kent Nagano as Principal Artistic Partner marks a significant milestone for the orchestra, as he brings his international acclaim and vision to the ensemble, fostering a dynamic and forward-looking artistic journey. La Toscanini actively participates in innovative projects, such as the PASS initiative, which promotes accessibility in the arts, ensuring that music remains a universal language for all. The orchestra collaborates with a variety of partners, including local governments, cultural institutions, and corporate sponsors like Barilla, to enhance its outreach and impact within the region and beyond. Its target audience includes classical music enthusiasts of all ages, families, and educational institutions, with programs designed to make music accessible to all. Notable initiatives include the "Nidi di Musica" program, which provides engaging workshops for children during concerts. La Toscanini's commitment to excellence is reflected in its diverse repertoire, ranging from baroque to contemporary works, and its active participation in international music festivals. Through its rich program of concerts, educational initiatives, and special projects that connect music with other disciplines, La Toscanini continues to enhance the cultural landscape and create memorable experiences for its audiences.

Name: HGV Hoteliers- Und Gastwirteverband
Company description: HGV Hoteliers- und Gastwirteverband è un'associazione che rappresenta e supporta gli albergatori e i ristoratori nella regione delle Dolomiti, in particolare a Santa Cristina in Val Gardena. La missione dell'associazione è promuovere l'ospitalità e la cultura locale, valorizzando le tradizioni ladine e il patrimonio naturale della zona, che è stato riconosciuto come Patrimonio Mondiale dell'UNESCO. HGV si impegna a fornire ai suoi membri risorse, formazione e opportunità di networking per migliorare la qualità dei servizi offerti ai turisti. I suoi clienti principali includono albergatori, ristoratori e operatori turistici, mentre i partner possono comprendere enti locali, associazioni culturali e istituzioni turistiche. L'associazione si rivolge a un mercato di viaggiatori in cerca di esperienze autentiche e di alta qualità nelle Dolomiti, promuovendo un turismo sostenibile e responsabile.

Name: Villa Cora
Company description: This elegant and exclusive 19th century Villa is located inside a centuries-old park surrounded by lush gardens that overlooks the Boboli Gardens on the hills of Florence only minutes away from the heart of the city. With 44 rooms and suites and magnificent common areas, you will feel as a true Florentine aristocratic. Each floor of the Villa is characterize by a particular style from Empress Eugenie and her passion for roses, to an oriental style, to the America of the 1950s. The roof terrace on the fifth floor has wonderful panoramic views of the city and surrounding hills and is the perfect spot for an aperitif prior to dining in Le Bistrot Restaurant located next to the heated outdoor pool open all year round during the summer and in the beautiful saloons in winter. To complete the full range of services, Guests can enjoy the BENè SPA with wellness and fitness center.  A complimentary shuttle operates at key points in the city and private parking is available.

Name: CDSHotels
Company description: CDSHotels gestisce Hotel e Resort in Puglia e nasce dall’amore per le tante bellezze del suo territorio. Il brand è il naturale risultato di anni di impegno nel settore dell’ospitalità profuso da professionisti motivati e orientati a creare un’offerta innovativa in grado di interpretare le esigenze dei turisti che vogliono godere del mare e di tutto il relax e il divertimento che la Puglia ha da offrire.  CDS Hotels significa qualità nei servizi, professionalità, affidabilità e cortesia, tutti requisiti indispensabili per rendere una semplice vacanza un’esperienza indimenticabile. L’offerta si rivolge a un pubblico di famiglie, giovani coppie e over 65 e propone una vacanza in raffinati ed accoglienti Hotel e Resort situati nei luoghi più belli della Puglia.

Name: Halldis By Vita
Company description: Halldis By Vita specializes in providing long-term rentals and vacation houses, primarily located in the picturesque Aosta Valley region of Italy, specifically in Gressoney-saint-jean. The company aims to offer comfortable and well-equipped accommodations that cater to both leisure and business travelers, ensuring a memorable stay in the Italian Alps. With a diverse portfolio of properties, Halldis By Vita targets families, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts looking for a serene getaway, while also welcoming pets upon request. The company values partnerships with property owners, encouraging them to list their properties and collaborate in delivering exceptional guest experiences. Through its commitment to quality service and customer satisfaction, Halldis By Vita strives to be a leading choice for travelers seeking a unique alpine retreat.

Name: Cosmopolitan Hotels Group
Company description: Cosmopolitan Hotels Group, founded in 2009, has established itself as a prominent player in the Tuscan hospitality sector, offering a blend of modern luxury, elegant comfort, and personalized service across its diverse range of hotels and resorts. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional accommodation solutions for various clientele, including business travelers and vacationers, ensuring that every stay is a moment of enchanting beauty. With a strong commitment to sustainability, Cosmopolitan Hotels Group is actively working towards reducing its environmental impact while promoting a culture of service and hospitality that reflects the elegance of Italian tradition. Its portfolio includes notable properties such as the Val di Luce SPA Resort and the Grand Hotel Salsomaggiore, catering to guests seeking wellness, relaxation, and memorable experiences in stunning locations from the mountains to the sea. The group's mission is to create unforgettable stays through a refined yet informal atmosphere, welcoming guests with a personal touch that meets their individual needs.

The Wilde will offer exceptional hospitality, world-class cultural programming, and a dynamic digital member experience. Founded in London by seasoned members’ club professionals, The Wilde will expand to Milan, London, New York, LA and other vibrant international destinations. ‘The Wilde sets the stage for incredible encounters’. Don’t forget to specify the position you're applying for in the subject line of your email.

Name: NIVEA SPA - Lavanderia Industriale
Company description: Nivea è la lavanderia industriale della Sardegna, leader nei settori turistico-alberghiero, industriale e navale, per i servizi di lavaggio, noleggio, sanificazione e prodotti per l'igiene e la pulizia. Nasce nel 1967 per scelta di Martino Ferraguti, modenese d’origine ma cagliaritano d’adozione e, fin dall’inizio, sceglie la strada dell’innovazione tecnologica, introducendo il tunnel di lavaggio continuo e realizzando, per la prima volta in Sardegna, un impianto Mec System in grado di produrre energia pulita, oltre a garantire notevoli risparmi energetici. Gli stabilimenti Nivea si trovano nelle zone industriali di Cagliari, Oristano, Porto Torres e Olbia.

Name: Pavarotti
Company description: Pavarotti is a vibrant dining establishment located in the heart of Leiden, renowned for its unique combination of a lively restaurant experience and the largest sea aquarium in Europe. The company specializes in traditional Italian cuisine, offering a diverse menu that includes not only classic dishes but also vegan options and allergen-friendly meals, ensuring that it caters to a wide range of dietary preferences. Pavarotti's mission is to create a family-friendly atmosphere where guests can enjoy delicious meals while being entertained by captivating marine life, making it a memorable destination for all. The restaurant is particularly popular among families, food enthusiasts, and karaoke lovers, providing a casual dining experience that is perfect for both everyday meals and special events. Pavarotti features themed karaoke rooms and a well-curated wine bar with over 18 varieties, enhancing the overall dining experience. The company is committed to inclusivity, offering vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options to ensure that everyone can enjoy their meals. With a strong focus on quality, passion, and craftsmanship, Pavarotti aims to transport guests to the sunny streets of Italy through high-quality ingredients and authentic cooking methods, including the use of traditional stone ovens for their pizzas. The restaurant also emphasizes sustainability and has established partnerships within the local community, further enhancing its commitment to exceptional service and a unique dining experience. Whether guests choose to dine in, take away, or enjoy delivery, Pavarotti strives to create memorable moments that leave a lasting impression.

Name: Vikey
Company description: Vikey is an Italian innovative start-up in the hospitality business, that allows hosts to check-in their guests with a 24/7 concierge, directly from their smartphone. Our goal is to offer a faster and more efficient solution to hosts, in order to improve their business quality standards and, at the same time, offering their customers unique experiences.  Vikey is present all over Italy and also in Spain, Portugal, Scotland, England and Dubai. To date Vikey has collected 1.6 million euros.

Francesco: nasce allora l'omonima focacceria, la cui fama si diffonde presto anche fra le èlites nobili e intellettuali dell'epoca. Nel 1848 Ruggero Settimo festeggia la sua elezione a capo del governo con sfincione e marsala della Focacceria; Garibaldi e i Mille vi si rifocillano prima dell'Unità nazionale; i Reali d'Italia, Spagna e Belgio, ma anche Pirandello, Crispi e molte altre illustri personalità vi assaporano i piatti ricchi di gusto della cucina "povera" di Palermo. Nel 1902, dopo un accurato restauro, il locale prende il nome di Antica Focacceria San Francesco. Ancora oggi, dopo cinque generazioni, i fratelli Conticello proseguono la tradizione gastronomica popolare palermitana: la pasta con le sarde, la focaccia schietta e maritata e l'intramontabile sfincione conservano i sapori e i profumi di una volta.

Numerous events and initiatives always fill the historic building with life and make it something very special. Nice that you visit us!

Name: EHMA - European Hotel Managers Association
Company description: The European Hotel Managers Association (EHMA) is the most relevant association for European 4- and 5-star hotels. Established in 1974, the mission of the Association is to be the number one platform for collective intelligence, education, networking and professional development among luxury European hotel managers.  You can learn more about how we are safeguarding and promoting the luxury hotel industry in Europe by visiting our website – www.EHMA.com

Name: City Hotels Company Holding Spa
Company description: City Hotels Company operates in the main important italian cities with a portfolio of five Holiday Inn branded hotels in Milan, Cinisello Balsamo (northern Milan), Turin, Genoa, Bologna, and one independent 4 stars hotel in Florence; moreover, a business Residence made up of 16 apartments for long stay in Genoa, and the new born BEST WESTERN PREMIER CHC Airport in Sestri Ponente-Genoa, a new design structure which represents the top of Best Western selection. A multi-decade hotel experience that shows and grant to every customer such as competence, elegance and distinction in hospitality.

Name: Hotel Riviera A Milano Marittima
Company description: L’Hotel sorge direttamente sul mare, con accesso diretto alla spiaggia e camere con emozionante vista panoramica. Circondato dal verde della bellissima Pineta di Milano Marittima, il nostro hotel è a 10 minuti a piedi dal centro ed a breve distanza da Cervia. La definizione di family hotel a Milano Marittima ci distingue per i servizi che riserviamo alle famiglie, sia in struttura che sull’arenile. In camera ed al ristorante mettiamo a disposizione tante comodità per i più piccoli, ed inoltre offriamo miniclub in hotel ed in spiaggia. •	Delizioso Ristorante Accomodatevi al nostro delizioso ristorante ed assaporate la cucina sana e genuina della Romagna, ogni giorno con 4 tipi di scelta e buffet di antipasti e verdure. Non perdetevi la prima colazione servita in giardino, e cominciate la giornata con la carica giusta. •	Adatto agli sportivi Organizzate la vostra vacanza attiva a Milano Marittima, a due passi dal nostro hotel trovate ottimi impianti sportivi per attività di ogni genere: dal tennis alla vela, dall’equitazione al golf, sono tante le opportunità per tenersi in forma anche in vacanza. Se non avete ancora pianificato le vostre vacanze a Milano Marittima, date un’occhiata alle nostre offerte ed approfittate di straordinarie last minute per rilassarvi sulla Riviera Romagnola!

Name: Costa Degli Ulivi Hotels S.p.A.
Company description: Quella di Costa degli Ulivi è un’avvincente storia che parla di professionisti che nei mesi successivi alla seconda guerra mondiale decisero di unirsi nel forte desiderio di ricreare un nuovo destino per sé e per la propria terra. In parallelo alle attività professionali già avviate, questo gruppo di giovani dallo spiccato spirito imprenditoriale ha portato avanti queste ardite idee con metodica tenacia. I temi dei progetti sono disparati, dalle navi traghetto, alberghi, stabilimenti balneari, bunkeraggio, stazioni sciistiche estive, porti turistici, allevamenti ittici, querce tartufigene, stabilimenti termali, circoli nautici, impianti geotermici, campi da golf e molto altro. Molte idee superarono la fase embrionale, e da semplici progetti si trasformarono in realtà aziendali, che giunsero ad esprimere specifiche compagini societarie. Nel 1967 nasce la Costa degli Ulivi S.p.A., società che da una parte raccoglie il testimone della gran mole di iniziative degli anni precedenti, dall'altra la volontà di concentrare tutti gli strumenti ed i servizi necessari per ogni singola struttura Alberghiera. Oltre mezzo secolo dopo, le strutture alberghiere della Costa degli Ulivi Hotels conservano ancora intatto lo spirito che contraddistinse quei pionieri. Un autentico fil rouge che unisce tutte, e che giustifica ampiamente il motto: “Strutture uniche in luoghi straordinari …” Ancora oggi le ardite idee e gli appunti ad esse correlate  sono conservati all'interno degli uffici della Costa degli Ulivi Spa che rappresenta ancora oggi uno dei progetti imprenditoriali più di successo nel territorio di Palermo. Negli anni 2000, la seconda generazione in linea con gli ambiziosi progetti dei genitori ha deciso di acquisire e ristruttura l’ex Cassa di Risparmio di Palermo creando una struttura di Lusso accessibile dando un chiaro segno alla propria e alle future generazioni che questa terra può e deve essere un posto dove poter costruire sogni, posti di lavoro e progetti ambiziosi.

Name: LHP HOTELS
Company description: LHP Hotels is a totally new-sprung concept of hospitality. It is a hotel brand name that you can encounter exactly in the heart of the most prestigious Italian hotel destinations.

Name: CPH | Pevero Hotel
Company description: Il Colonna Pevero Hotel è posizionato fra dolci pendii nella quiete di un parco, dove gli intensi profumi e colori della macchia mediterranea rendono l’atmosfera davvero speciale. E’ situato a Porto Cervo, in prossimità delle incantevoli e famose spiagge del Pevero, nel cuore della Costa Smeralda, sinonimo di lusso, esclusività e glamour. Una location privilegiata, capace di trasmettere emozioni uniche, dedicata a chi ama essere circondato da un’atmosfera raffinata. Dalle terrazze dell’hotel si ammira in tutta la sua bellezza il Golfo Del Pevero. Ideale per soggiorni di vacanza ed eventi come matrimoni, meeting ed incentive aziendali.

Name: Borgo Santandrea Relais & Châteaux
HQ Location: Italy, Salerno, Amalfi, 33 Via Giovanni Augustariccio, 84011
Company description: Borgo Santandrea opens in July 2021, following an extensive four-year renovation. The cliffside 5-star hotel is an iconic property in one of the most beautiful corners of the Amalfi coast, overlooking the fishermen’ village of Conca dei Marini. It represents seductive blend of Italian style, local charm and natural beauty, where mid-century design meets Mediterranean style. The hotel is a passion project that unites two Italian families, the Orlacchio and De Siano’s, and offers 29 rooms and 16 suites, all with sea views. The rooms are appointed with a collection of 31 local handmade tiles and bespoke furniture, which are there to frame the stunning blue of the sea that can be enjoyed at every turn. Guests are seamlessly connected to Borgo Santandrea’s private beach by a series of walkways and fragrant Mediterranean gardens. The hotel boasts a private jetty, an exclusive beach club, a fitness & wellness center, and three restaurants serving the Italian cuisine with regional and Mediterranean flavors twisted in a modern way. A panoramic pool surrounded by terraced gardens, an intimate escape, conceived in harmony with the spectacular native coastal landscapes of the region, provides a link between the core of the hotel and the magnificent private beach.

Name: Hotel Monaco & Grand Canal
Company description: You will find the Hotel Monaco & Grand Canal a stone’s throw from Piazza San Marco, looking out over the point where the Grand Canal meets the waters of St. Mark’s Basin. The hotel is set against one of Venice’s most fascinating and evocative backdrops, from where you can enjoy a breath-taking view over the Basilica della Salute, Punta della Dogana and the islands of Giudecca and San Giorgio, alongside Ca’ Giustinian, historic Biennale venue.

Name: Riva Degli Etruschi - Tuscany Italy
HQ Location: Italy, Tuscany, San, 120 Via Della Principessa, 57027
Company description: Riva degli Etruschi is a resort located right on the sea of Tuscany at San Vincenzo, inside a beautiful maritme pine forest

Name: Roscioli Hotels
Company description: La famiglia Roscioli è protagonista dell’ospitalità italiana da oltre 90 anni con i suoi alberghi presenti a Roma e Milano in posizioni centrali e strategiche per il target business e leisure e oltre 700 camere, 3 centri congressi, 4 ristoranti, 3 sale fitness e 2 centri benessere. Oggi è attiva ed operativa sul mercato con la RGR Hotel Service e la LVRH Service.

Name: Grand Hotel La Favorita
Company description: Grand hotel la Favorita Sorrento, è un prestigioso hotel 5 stelle a Sorrento immerso in un rigoglioso giardino mediterraneo. Situato nel centro storico di Sorrento e con il Golfo di Napoli che fa da sfondo, il Grand Hotel la Favorita vanta una posizione ottimale a pochi passi dal mare

Name: Gruppo Niko Romito
Company description: Gruppo Niko Romito is a culinary enterprise founded by the acclaimed chef Niko Romito, known for his innovative approach to Italian cuisine. The company operates the prestigious Ristorante Reale, which has earned three Michelin stars, and the Accademia Niko Romito, a school dedicated to high-level culinary training. Gruppo Niko Romito aims to blend tradition with modernity, focusing on research, creativity, and quality in gastronomy. Recently, the company has expanded its reach through a partnership with Enilive, launching the "ALT Stazione del Gusto" concept, which transforms service stations into dining experiences, targeting travelers and families seeking quality food on the go. The mission of the group is to create new business opportunities for young entrepreneurs and chefs while promoting a culture of excellence in the culinary arts. Through its innovative formats and commitment to training, Gruppo Niko Romito is poised to redefine the dining landscape in Italy and beyond.

Name: HPoint
Company description: Fondata nel 2011 da Giovanni Borriello, Vincenzo Monteleone e Francois Attardo, HPoint è un'organizzazione specializzata nell'erogazione di servizi in outsourcing per hotel in tutto il territorio italiano.  Un vero punto di riferimento per tutti coloro che cercano soluzioni flessibili per soddisfare le esigenze del proprio albergo e migliorarne le performance in termini di rendimento economico. Comprovata esperienza maturata nel settore dell’industria turistico alberghiera, profonda conoscenza delle dinamiche operative e eccezionale capacità di far fronte alle criticità, rendono HPoint un interlocutore privilegiato per tutti gli alberghi.  Dalla gestione reception al riassetto camera, fino alle pulizie speciali e alla manutenzione, la società è in grado di fornire supporto in vari reparti dell'albergo.   Vision Lo sguardo rivolto al futuro, un approccio semplificato al mercato, una continua innovazione dei propri servizi.

Name: CRIPPACONCEPT
HQ Location: Italy, Pv, Torre D'isola, 9 Via Del Commercio, 27020
Company description: Crippacampeggio S.r.l. is one of the most authoritative and well-known companies in the glamour camping culture in Italy and Europe. Founded in 1975 by the Crippa family as a producer of camping tents, the company experienced significant growth and development in the 2000s. Since 2010, while retaining all its previous know-how, the company has completely converted its production to create mobile living units dedicated to the open-air tourism sector. A few years later, to formalise the change in target and production, it registered a new brand, Crippaconcept®. Over time, the company has positioned itself as a benchmark for high-quality product proposals, events, and initiatives dedicated to promoting and enhancing open-air tourism, aimed at both industry professionals and the general public. Thanks to its communication drive and the presentation of always trendy living units, Crippaconcept has stimulated an undeniable demand for alternative hospitality solutions. For this reason, it can create a simple, scalable product adaptable to the various needs and requirements of Camping Villages.

Name: Vertical Booking CRS - Zucchetti Group
